TS037 no-abbreviations

A name spells its words out, because an abbreviation saves a few characters and costs every later reader.

languages: go javascript odin python rust typescript zig
severity: info
default: opt-in
group: stable

TigerStyle: "Do not abbreviate variable names, unless the variable is a primitive integer type used as an argument to a sort function or matrix calculation. Use long form arguments in scripts: `--force`, not `-f`. Single letter flags are for interactive usage."
